title: Jefferson City, MO — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Jefferson City, MO: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Jefferson City is a city in MO with a population of 43,000. Missouri’s capital on the Missouri River with the State Capitol and Katy Trail. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
